import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import gc
import os
import re
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
import xgboost as xgb
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast
import warnings
import textstat

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

X_train_raw = train_df["text"].values
y_train_raw = train_df["author"].values
X_test_raw = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Encode labels
label_enc = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = label_enc.fit_transform(y_train_raw)
num_classes = len(label_enc.classes_)

# Stratified train/val split
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded,
)

print(
    f"Train size: {len(X_train)}, Val size: {len(X_val)}, Test size: {len(X_test_raw)}"
)

# =============================================
# Feature Engineering Functions (from Step 1)
# =============================================


def extract_stylometric_features(text_series):
    features = []
    for text in text_series:
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        char_count = len(text_str)
        word_count = len(words)
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)
        punctuation = sum(1 for c in text_str if c in ".,;:!?\"'()[]-")
        punct_density = punctuation / max(char_count, 1)
        caps_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isupper())
        caps_ratio = caps_count / max(char_count, 1)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        digit_ratio = digit_count / max(char_count, 1)
        word_lengths = [len(w) for w in words] if words else [0]
        avg_word_len = np.mean(word_lengths)
        max_word_len = max(word_lengths)
        long_words_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / max(word_count, 1)
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        avg_sent_len = np.mean(sent_lengths)
        max_sent_len = max(sent_lengths)
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 1 else 0
        unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        unique_ratio = unique_words / max(word_count, 1)
        try:
            fk_grade = textstat.flesch_kincaid_grade(text_str)
        except:
            fk_grade = 0
        try:
            coleman_liau = textstat.coleman_liau_index(text_str)
        except:
            coleman_liau = 0
        features.append(
            [
                punct_density,
                caps_ratio,
                digit_ratio,
                avg_word_len,
                max_word_len,
                long_words_ratio,
                avg_sent_len,
                max_sent_len,
                sent_len_std,
                unique_ratio,
                fk_grade,
                coleman_liau,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


def extract_pos_style_features(text_series):
    features = []
    for text in text_series:
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = max(len(words), 1)
        pronoun_pattern = r"\b(I|you|he|she|it|we|they|me|him|her|us|them|my|your|his|her|its|our|their|mine|yours|hers|ours|theirs)\b"
        pronouns = len(re.findall(pronoun_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        pronoun_ratio = pronouns / word_count
        article_pattern = r"\b(a|an|the)\b"
        articles = len(re.findall(article_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        article_ratio = articles / word_count
        prep_pattern = r"\b(in|on|at|to|for|with|by|from|of|about|into|through|during|before|after|above|below|between|under|over)\b"
        prepositions = len(re.findall(prep_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        prep_ratio = prepositions / word_count
        conj_pattern = r"\b(and|but|or|nor|yet|so|for|because|although|while|since|unless|if|when|where|whether)\b"
        conjunctions = len(re.findall(conj_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        conj_ratio = conjunctions / word_count
        adverbs = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("ly"))
        adv_ratio = adverbs / word_count
        past_tense = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("ed") and len(w) > 3)
        present_part = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("ing") and len(w) > 4)
        verb_marker_ratio = (past_tense + present_part) / word_count
        question_marks = text_str.count("?")
        exclam_marks = text_str.count("!")
        punctuation_markers = (question_marks + exclam_marks) / max(len(text_str), 1)
        ellipsis = text_str.count("...") + text_str.count("--")
        punctuation_density = ellipsis / max(len(text_str), 1)
        features.append(
            [
                pronoun_ratio,
                article_ratio,
                prep_ratio,
                conj_ratio,
                adv_ratio,
                verb_marker_ratio,
                punctuation_markers,
                punctuation_density,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


def create_tfidf_features(train_texts, val_texts, test_texts, max_features=2000):
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=max_features,
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        analyzer="char_wb",
        min_df=5,
        max_df=0.9,
        sublinear_tf=True,
    )
    tfidf_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
    tfidf_val = vectorizer.transform(val_texts)
    tfidf_test = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)
    return tfidf_train, tfidf_val, tfidf_test, vectorizer


def create_word_ngram_features(train_texts, val_texts, test_texts, max_features=1500):
    vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
        max_features=max_features, ngram_range=(1, 4), min_df=3, max_df=0.95
    )
    ngram_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
    ngram_val = vectorizer.transform(val_texts)
    ngram_test = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)
    return ngram_train, ngram_val, ngram_test, vectorizer


# Extract classical features
print("Extracting classical features...")
styl_train = extract_stylometric_features(X_train)
styl_val = extract_stylometric_features(X_val)
styl_test = extract_stylometric_features(X_test_raw)

pos_train = extract_pos_style_features(X_train)
pos_val = extract_pos_style_features(X_val)
pos_test = extract_pos_style_features(X_test_raw)

char_tfidf_train, char_tfidf_val, char_tfidf_test, _ = create_tfidf_features(
    X_train, X_val, X_test_raw, max_features=2000
)
word_ngram_train, word_ngram_val, word_ngram_test, _ = create_word_ngram_features(
    X_train, X_val, X_test_raw, max_features=1500
)

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
styl_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(styl_train)
styl_val_scaled = scaler.transform(styl_val)
styl_test_scaled = scaler.transform(styl_test)

pos_scaler = StandardScaler()
pos_train_scaled = pos_scaler.fit_transform(pos_train)
pos_val_scaled = pos_scaler.transform(pos_val)
pos_test_scaled = pos_scaler.transform(pos_test)

X_train_features = hstack(
    [
        csr_matrix(styl_train_scaled),
        csr_matrix(pos_train_scaled),
        char_tfidf_train,
        word_ngram_train,
    ]
)
X_val_features = hstack(
    [
        csr_matrix(styl_val_scaled),
        csr_matrix(pos_val_scaled),
        char_tfidf_val,
        word_ngram_val,
    ]
)
X_test_features = hstack(
    [
        csr_matrix(styl_test_scaled),
        csr_matrix(pos_test_scaled),
        char_tfidf_test,
        word_ngram_test,
    ]
)

print(
    f"Classical features shape - Train: {X_train_features.shape}, Val: {X_val_features.shape}, Test: {X_test_features.shape}"
)

# =============================================
# DeBERTa-v3-large Feature Extraction
# =============================================
print("Loading DeBERTa-v3-large...")
MODEL_NAME = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large"
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = model.cuda()
model.eval()
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
print(
    f"DeBERTa-v3-large loaded. Parameters frozen: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}"
)


def extract_embeddings(texts, batch_size=16, max_length=512):
    embeddings = []
    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch_texts = texts[i : i + batch_size]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            (
                batch_texts.tolist()
                if hasattr(batch_texts, "tolist")
                else list(batch_texts)
            ),
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding=True,
            truncation=True,
            max_length=max_length,
        )
        inputs = {k: v.cuda() for k, v in inputs.items()}
        with torch.no_grad(), autocast():
            outputs = model(**inputs, output_hidden_states=True)
            hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-2]
            attention_mask = inputs["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(-1).float()
            pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask).sum(dim=1) / attention_mask.sum(
                dim=1
            )
            embeddings.append(pooled.cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(embeddings)


print("Extracting DeBERTa embeddings...")
train_emb = extract_embeddings(X_train)
val_emb = extract_embeddings(X_val)
test_emb = extract_embeddings(X_test_raw)

# Convert sparse classical features to dense numpy for stacking
X_train_dense = X_train_features.toarray()
X_val_dense = X_val_features.toarray()
X_test_dense = X_test_features.toarray()

# Combine all features
X_train_combined = np.hstack([train_emb, X_train_dense])
X_val_combined = np.hstack([val_emb, X_val_dense])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([test_emb, X_test_dense])

print(
    f"Combined feature shapes - Train: {X_train_combined.shape}, Val: {X_val_combined.shape}, Test: {X_test_combined.shape}"
)

# =============================================
# XGBoost Training (Two-Stage with Hard Negative Mining)
# =============================================
print("Setting up XGBoost...")
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
val_scores = []
val_preds_list = []
val_true_list = []

xgb_params = {
    "objective": "multi:softprob",
    "num_class": num_classes,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 1,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 2.0,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "eval_metric": "mlogloss",
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "verbosity": 0,
}

print("Training XGBoost with cross-validation (using combined train data)...")
all_train_combined = np.vstack([X_train_combined, X_val_combined])
all_y = np.concatenate([y_train, y_val])

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(all_train_combined, all_y)):
    X_tr, X_val_fold = all_train_combined[train_idx], all_train_combined[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val_fold = all_y[train_idx], all_y[val_idx]

    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_fold, label=y_val_fold)

    model_xgb = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=500,
        evals=[(dval, "val")],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )

    val_pred = model_xgb.predict(dval)
    fold_score = log_loss(y_val_fold, val_pred)
    val_scores.append(fold_score)
    val_preds_list.append(val_pred)
    val_true_list.append(y_val_fold)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1}/{n_splits} - Log Loss: {fold_score:.4f}")

all_val_preds = np.vstack(val_preds_list)
all_val_true = np.concatenate(val_true_list)
overall_val_score = log_loss(all_val_true, all_val_preds)
print(
    f"Cross-Validation Log Loss: {overall_val_score:.4f} (mean: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f})"
)

# Stage 1: Retrain on full data
print("Training Stage 1 XGBoost on full training data...")
dtrain_full = xgb.DMatrix(all_train_combined, label=all_y)
stage1_model = xgb.train(
    xgb_params, dtrain_full, num_boost_round=500, verbose_eval=False
)

# Stage 2: Hard Negative Mining (using Out-of-Fold predictions)
print("Stage 2: Hard Negative Mining...")
# For each sample, get predicted probability for the true class from OOF predictions
true_probs = all_val_preds[np.arange(len(all_val_true)), all_val_true]
# Identify hard examples (bottom 20% by predicted probability for the true class)
threshold = np.percentile(true_probs, 20)
hard_mask = true_probs < threshold
print(f"Hard examples identified: {hard_mask.sum()} out of {len(true_probs)}")

# Create sample weights: weight=2 for hard examples, weight=1 for others
sample_weights = np.ones(len(all_y))
sample_weights[hard_mask] = 2.0

# Retrain a second XGBoost model using instance weights on full training data
print("Training Stage 2 XGBoost with hard negative weights...")
dtrain_weighted = xgb.DMatrix(all_train_combined, label=all_y, weight=sample_weights)
stage2_model = xgb.train(
    xgb_params, dtrain_weighted, num_boost_round=500, verbose_eval=False
)

# Ensemble: average predictions from both models
print("Generating test predictions (ensemble)...")
dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test_combined)
stage1_probs = stage1_model.predict(dtest)
stage2_probs = stage2_model.predict(dtest)
test_probs = (stage1_probs + stage2_probs) / 2.0

# Create submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

# Normalize probabilities
row_sums = submission_df[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)

def extract_embeddings(texts, batch_size=16, max_length=512):
    embeddings = []
    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch_texts = texts[i : i + batch_size]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            (
                batch_texts.tolist()
                if hasattr(batch_texts, "tolist")
                else list(batch_texts)
            ),
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding=True,
            truncation=True,
            max_length=max_length,
        )
        inputs = {k: v.cuda() for k, v in inputs.items()}
        with torch.no_grad(), autocast():
            outputs = model(**inputs, output_hidden_states=True)
            hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-2]
            attention_mask = inputs["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(-1).float()
            pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask).sum(dim=1) / attention_mask.sum(
                dim=1
            )
            embeddings.append(pooled.cpu().numpy())

def get_wordnet_synonyms(word):
    """Get synonyms for a word using WordNet. Returns empty list if WordNet is unavailable."""
    try:
        synonyms = set()
        for syn in wordnet.synsets(word):
            for lemma in syn.lemmas():
                synonym = lemma.name().replace('_', ' ')
                if synonym.lower() != word.lower():
                    synonyms.add(synonym)
        return list(synonyms)
    except Exception:
        return []

class AuthorDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])

        # Apply synonym replacement augmentation during training with probability 0.3
        if self.augment and np.random.random() < 0.3:
            tokens = text.split()
            augmented_tokens = []
            for token in tokens:
                # Skip stopwords and non-alpha tokens
                if token.lower() in stop_words or not token.isalpha():
                    augmented_tokens.append(token)
                elif np.random.random() < 0.15:
                    # Try to replace with a synonym
                    synonyms = get_wordnet_synonyms(token)
                    if synonyms:
                        # Use original capitalization style
                        if token[0].isupper():
                            synonym = np.random.choice(synonyms).capitalize()
                        else:
                            synonym = np.random.choice(synonyms).lower()
                        augmented_tokens.append(synonym)
                    else:
                        augmented_tokens.append(token)
                else:
                    augmented_tokens.append(token)
            text = ' '.join(augmented_tokens)

        encoding = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),

        if self.labels is not None:

    if current_step < warmup_steps:

        return float(current_step) / float(max(1, warmup_steps))
    else:

                )

class HierarchicalModernBERT(nn.Module):
    """ModernBERT with hierarchical multi-scale pooling from intermediate layers."""

    def __init__(self, model_id, num_labels=3, pool_layers=[12, 16, 20, 24], pool_dim=512, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        # Load the base ModernBERT model without the default classification head
        self.bert = ModernBertModel.from_pretrained(model_id)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.pool_layers = pool_layers
        self.pool_dim = pool_dim
        self.hidden_size = self.bert.config.hidden_size

        # Learnable per-layer attention pooling
        self.per_layer_attn_pool = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
                nn.Tanh(),
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, 1)
            ) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Layer normalization after per-layer pooling
        self.per_layer_norm = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Combine concatenated multi-layer features
        combined_dim = len(pool_layers) * self.hidden_size
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(combined_dim, 1024)
        self.fc1_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1024)
        self.fc1_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(1024, num_labels)

        # Initialize weights
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.fc1, self.fc2]:
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        # Initialize attention scores with small weights
        for attn_pool in self.per_layer_attn_pool.values():
            for layer in attn_pool:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight, gain=0.1)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=True):
        # Forward through ModernBERT with hidden states from all layers
        outputs = self.bert(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True
        )

        # Get all hidden states (including embedding layer)
        all_hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Extract and pool hidden states from specified layers
        pooled_features = []
        for layer_idx in self.pool_layers:
            # Hidden states index: all_hidden_states[0] = embeddings, all_hidden_states[1] = layer 1, etc.
            # So layer L corresponds to index L
            layer_hidden = all_hidden_states[layer_idx]  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

            # Compute attention scores for this layer
            attn_weights = self.per_layer_attn_pool[str(layer_idx)](layer_hidden)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
            # Mask attention for padding tokens
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
                attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attn_mask == 0, -1e9)

            # Softmax over sequence dimension
            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            # Weighted sum pooling
            pooled = torch.sum(layer_hidden * attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

            # Apply layer normalization
            pooled = self.per_layer_norm[str(layer_idx)](pooled)
            pooled_features.append(pooled)

        # Concatenate all pooled features
        combined = torch.cat(pooled_features, dim=-1)  # (batch, combined_dim)

        # Pass through MLP head
        x = self.fc1(combined)
        x = self.fc1_norm(x)
        x = F.gelu(x)
        x = self.fc1_dropout(x)
        logits = self.fc2(x)  # (batch, num_labels)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
            loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)

        return type('ModelOutput', (), {'logits': logits, 'loss': loss})()

class HierarchicalModernBERT(nn.Module):
    """ModernBERT with hierarchical multi-scale pooling from intermediate layers."""

    def __init__(self, model_id, num_labels=3, pool_layers=[12, 16, 20, 24], pool_dim=512, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        # Load the base ModernBERT model without the default classification head
        self.bert = ModernBertModel.from_pretrained(model_id)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.pool_layers = pool_layers
        self.pool_dim = pool_dim
        self.hidden_size = self.bert.config.hidden_size

        # Learnable per-layer attention pooling
        self.per_layer_attn_pool = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
                nn.Tanh(),
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, 1)
            ) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Layer normalization after per-layer pooling
        self.per_layer_norm = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Combine concatenated multi-layer features
        combined_dim = len(pool_layers) * self.hidden_size
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(combined_dim, 1024)
        self.fc1_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1024)
        self.fc1_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(1024, num_labels)

        # Initialize weights
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.fc1, self.fc2]:
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        # Initialize attention scores with small weights
        for attn_pool in self.per_layer_attn_pool.values():
            for layer in attn_pool:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight, gain=0.1)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=True):
        # Forward through ModernBERT with hidden states from all layers
        outputs = self.bert(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True
        )

        # Get all hidden states (including embedding layer)
        all_hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Extract and pool hidden states from specified layers
        pooled_features = []
        for layer_idx in self.pool_layers:
            # Hidden states index: all_hidden_states[0] = embeddings, all_hidden_states[1] = layer 1, etc.
            # So layer L corresponds to index L
            layer_hidden = all_hidden_states[layer_idx]  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

            # Compute attention scores for this layer
            attn_weights = self.per_layer_attn_pool[str(layer_idx)](layer_hidden)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
            # Mask attention for padding tokens
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
                attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attn_mask == 0, -1e9)

            # Softmax over sequence dimension
            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            # Weighted sum pooling
            pooled = torch.sum(layer_hidden * attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

            # Apply layer normalization
            pooled = self.per_layer_norm[str(layer_idx)](pooled)
            pooled_features.append(pooled)

        # Concatenate all pooled features
        combined = torch.cat(pooled_features, dim=-1)  # (batch, combined_dim)

        # Pass through MLP head
        x = self.fc1(combined)
        x = self.fc1_norm(x)
        x = F.gelu(x)
        x = self.fc1_dropout(x)
        logits = self.fc2(x)  # (batch, num_labels)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
            loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)

        return type('ModelOutput', (), {'logits': logits, 'loss': loss})()

print(f"Max sequence length: {max_length}")


# Custom Hierarchical Multi-Scale Pooling Model
class HierarchicalModernBERT(nn.Module):
    """ModernBERT with hierarchical multi-scale pooling from intermediate layers."""

    def __init__(self, model_id, num_labels=3, pool_layers=[12, 16, 20, 24], pool_dim=512, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        # Load the base ModernBERT model without the default classification head
        self.bert = ModernBertModel.from_pretrained(model_id)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.pool_layers = pool_layers
        self.pool_dim = pool_dim
        self.hidden_size = self.bert.config.hidden_size

        # Learnable per-layer attention pooling
        self.per_layer_attn_pool = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
                nn.Tanh(),
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, 1)
            ) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Layer normalization after per-layer pooling
        self.per_layer_norm = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Combine concatenated multi-layer features
        combined_dim = len(pool_layers) * self.hidden_size
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(combined_dim, 1024)
        self.fc1_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1024)
        self.fc1_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(1024, num_labels)

        # Initialize weights
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.fc1, self.fc2]:
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        # Initialize attention scores with small weights
        for attn_pool in self.per_layer_attn_pool.values():
            for layer in attn_pool:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight, gain=0.1)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=True):
        # Forward through ModernBERT with hidden states from all layers
        outputs = self.bert(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True
        )

        # Get all hidden states (including embedding layer)
        all_hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Extract and pool hidden states from specified layers
        pooled_features = []
        for layer_idx in self.pool_layers:
            # Hidden states index: all_hidden_states[0] = embeddings, all_hidden_states[1] = layer 1, etc.
            # So layer L corresponds to index L
            layer_hidden = all_hidden_states[layer_idx]  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

            # Compute attention scores for this layer
            attn_weights = self.per_layer_attn_pool[str(layer_idx)](layer_hidden)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
            # Mask attention for padding tokens
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
                attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attn_mask == 0, -1e9)

            # Softmax over sequence dimension
            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            # Weighted sum pooling
            pooled = torch.sum(layer_hidden * attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

            # Apply layer normalization
            pooled = self.per_layer_norm[str(layer_idx)](pooled)
            pooled_features.append(pooled)

        # Concatenate all pooled features
        combined = torch.cat(pooled_features, dim=-1)  # (batch, combined_dim)

        # Pass through MLP head
        x = self.fc1(combined)
        x = self.fc1_norm(x)
        x = F.gelu(x)
        x = self.fc1_dropout(x)
        logits = self.fc2(x)  # (batch, num_labels)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
            loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)

        return type('ModelOutput', (), {'logits': logits, 'loss': loss})()

            str(l): nn.Sequential(

        combined_dim = len(pool_layers) * self.hidden_size
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(combined_dim, 1024)

            if module.bias is not None:

        # Initialize attention scores with small weights
        for attn_pool in self.per_layer_attn_pool.values():
            for layer in attn_pool:

                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)

            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True
        )

        # Get all hidden states (including embedding layer)
        all_hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Extract and pool hidden states from specified layers
        pooled_features = []
        for layer_idx in self.pool_layers:
            # Hidden states index: all_hidden_states[0] = embeddings, all_hidden_states[1] = layer 1, etc.
            # So layer L corresponds to index L
            layer_hidden = all_hidden_states[layer_idx]  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

            # Compute attention scores for this layer
            attn_weights = self.per_layer_attn_pool[str(layer_idx)](layer_hidden)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            pooled = torch.sum(layer_hidden * attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

            pooled = self.per_layer_norm[str(layer_idx)](pooled)

        combined = torch.cat(pooled_features, dim=-1)  # (batch, combined_dim)

class HierarchicalModernBERT(nn.Module):
    """ModernBERT with hierarchical multi-scale pooling from intermediate layers."""

    def __init__(self, model_id, num_labels=3, pool_layers=[12, 16, 20, 24], pool_dim=512, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        # Load the base ModernBERT model without the default classification head
        self.bert = ModernBertModel.from_pretrained(model_id)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.pool_layers = pool_layers
        self.pool_dim = pool_dim
        self.hidden_size = self.bert.config.hidden_size

        # Learnable per-layer attention pooling
        self.per_layer_attn_pool = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
                nn.Tanh(),
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, 1)
            ) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Layer normalization after per-layer pooling
        self.per_layer_norm = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Combine concatenated multi-layer features
        combined_dim = len(pool_layers) * self.hidden_size
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(combined_dim, 1024)
        self.fc1_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1024)
        self.fc1_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(1024, num_labels)

        # Initialize weights
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.fc1, self.fc2]:
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        # Initialize attention scores with small weights
        for attn_pool in self.per_layer_attn_pool.values():
            for layer in attn_pool:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight, gain=0.1)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=True):
        # Forward through ModernBERT with hidden states from all layers
        outputs = self.bert(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True
        )

        # Get all hidden states (including embedding layer)
        all_hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Extract and pool hidden states from specified layers
        pooled_features = []
        for layer_idx in self.pool_layers:
            # Hidden states index: all_hidden_states[0] = embeddings, all_hidden_states[1] = layer 1, etc.
            # So layer L corresponds to index L
            layer_hidden = all_hidden_states[layer_idx]  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

            # Compute attention scores for this layer
            attn_weights = self.per_layer_attn_pool[str(layer_idx)](layer_hidden)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
            # Mask attention for padding tokens
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
                attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attn_mask == 0, -1e9)

            # Softmax over sequence dimension
            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            # Weighted sum pooling
            pooled = torch.sum(layer_hidden * attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

            # Apply layer normalization
            pooled = self.per_layer_norm[str(layer_idx)](pooled)
            pooled_features.append(pooled)

        # Concatenate all pooled features
        combined = torch.cat(pooled_features, dim=-1)  # (batch, combined_dim)

        # Pass through MLP head
        x = self.fc1(combined)
        x = self.fc1_norm(x)
        x = F.gelu(x)
        x = self.fc1_dropout(x)
        logits = self.fc2(x)  # (batch, num_labels)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
            loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)

        return type('ModelOutput', (), {'logits': logits, 'loss': loss})()

class HierarchicalModernBERT(nn.Module):
    """ModernBERT with hierarchical multi-scale pooling from intermediate layers."""

    def __init__(self, model_id, num_labels=3, pool_layers=[12, 16, 20, 24], pool_dim=512, dropout=0.3):

        # Load the base ModernBERT model without the default classification head
        self.bert = ModernBertModel.from_pretrained(model_id)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.pool_layers = pool_layers
        self.pool_dim = pool_dim
        self.hidden_size = self.bert.config.hidden_size

        # Learnable per-layer attention pooling
        self.per_layer_attn_pool = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
                nn.Tanh(),
                nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, 1)
            ) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Layer normalization after per-layer pooling
        self.per_layer_norm = nn.ModuleDict({
            str(l): nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size) for l in pool_layers
        })

        # Combine concatenated multi-layer features
        combined_dim = len(pool_layers) * self.hidden_size
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(combined_dim, 1024)
        self.fc1_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1024)
        self.fc1_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(1024, num_labels)

        # Initialize weights
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.fc1, self.fc2]:
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        # Initialize attention scores with small weights
        for attn_pool in self.per_layer_attn_pool.values():
            for layer in attn_pool:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight, gain=0.1)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.zeros_(layer.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=True):
        # Forward through ModernBERT with hidden states from all layers
        outputs = self.bert(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True
        )

        # Get all hidden states (including embedding layer)
        all_hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Extract and pool hidden states from specified layers
        pooled_features = []
        for layer_idx in self.pool_layers:
            # Hidden states index: all_hidden_states[0] = embeddings, all_hidden_states[1] = layer 1, etc.
            # So layer L corresponds to index L
            layer_hidden = all_hidden_states[layer_idx]  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

            # Compute attention scores for this layer
            attn_weights = self.per_layer_attn_pool[str(layer_idx)](layer_hidden)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
            # Mask attention for padding tokens
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
                attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attn_mask == 0, -1e9)

            # Softmax over sequence dimension
            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)

            # Weighted sum pooling
            pooled = torch.sum(layer_hidden * attn_weights, dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

            # Apply layer normalization
            pooled = self.per_layer_norm[str(layer_idx)](pooled)
            pooled_features.append(pooled)

        # Concatenate all pooled features
        combined = torch.cat(pooled_features, dim=-1)  # (batch, combined_dim)

        # Pass through MLP head
        x = self.fc1(combined)
        x = self.fc1_norm(x)
        x = F.gelu(x)
        x = self.fc1_dropout(x)
        logits = self.fc2(x)  # (batch, num_labels)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
            loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)

        return type('ModelOutput', (), {'logits': logits, 'loss': loss})()

def compute_stylometric_features(text):

    features['punct_density'] = punct_count / total_chars

    # Uppercase ratio
    uppercase_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isupper())
    features['uppercase_ratio'] = uppercase_count / total_chars

    # Average sentence length (in words)
    avg_sentence_len = total_words / total_sentences
    features['avg_sentence_len'] = avg_sentence_len

    stopword_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in stopwords)

    # Comma ratio

    """Compute POS-based linguistic features."""
    features = {}
    text_str = str(text)
    if len(text_str.strip()) == 0:

        features['article_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['preposition_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['adjective_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['adverb_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['verb_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['noun_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['proper_noun_ratio'] = 0.0
        return features

    doc = nlp(text_str[:10000])  # Limit to 10000 chars for speed

    pos_counts = {}
    for token in doc:
        pos = token.pos_
        pos_counts[pos] = pos_counts.get(pos, 0) + 1

    features['article_ratio'] = pos_counts.get('DET', 0) / total_tokens
    features['preposition_ratio'] = pos_counts.get('ADP', 0) / total_tokens

    features['verb_ratio'] = pos_counts.get('VERB', 0) / total_tokens
    features['noun_ratio'] = pos_counts.get('NOUN', 0) / total_tokens
    features['proper_noun_ratio'] = pos_counts.get('PROPN', 0) / total_tokens

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import gc
import os
import re
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
import xgboost as xgb
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast
import warnings
import textstat

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

X_train_raw = train_df["text"].values
y_train_raw = train_df["author"].values
X_test_raw = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Encode labels
label_enc = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = label_enc.fit_transform(y_train_raw)
num_classes = len(label_enc.classes_)

# Stratified train/val split
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded,
)

print(
    f"Train size: {len(X_train)}, Val size: {len(X_val)}, Test size: {len(X_test_raw)}"
)

# =============================================
# Feature Engineering Functions (from Step 1)
# =============================================


def extract_stylometric_features(text_series):
    features = []
    for text in text_series:
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        char_count = len(text_str)
        word_count = len(words)
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)
        punctuation = sum(1 for c in text_str if c in ".,;:!?\"'()[]-")
        punct_density = punctuation / max(char_count, 1)
        caps_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isupper())
        caps_ratio = caps_count / max(char_count, 1)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        digit_ratio = digit_count / max(char_count, 1)
        word_lengths = [len(w) for w in words] if words else [0]
        avg_word_len = np.mean(word_lengths)
        max_word_len = max(word_lengths)
        long_words_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / max(word_count, 1)
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        avg_sent_len = np.mean(sent_lengths)
        max_sent_len = max(sent_lengths)
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 1 else 0
        unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        unique_ratio = unique_words / max(word_count, 1)
        try:
            fk_grade = textstat.flesch_kincaid_grade(text_str)
        except:
            fk_grade = 0
        try:
            coleman_liau = textstat.coleman_liau_index(text_str)
        except:
            coleman_liau = 0
        features.append(
            [
                punct_density,
                caps_ratio,
                digit_ratio,
                avg_word_len,
                max_word_len,
                long_words_ratio,
                avg_sent_len,
                max_sent_len,
                sent_len_std,
                unique_ratio,
                fk_grade,
                coleman_liau,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


def extract_pos_style_features(text_series):
    features = []
    for text in text_series:
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = max(len(words), 1)
        pronoun_pattern = r"\b(I|you|he|she|it|we|they|me|him|her|us|them|my|your|his|her|its|our|their|mine|yours|hers|ours|theirs)\b"
        pronouns = len(re.findall(pronoun_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        pronoun_ratio = pronouns / word_count
        article_pattern = r"\b(a|an|the)\b"
        articles = len(re.findall(article_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        article_ratio = articles / word_count
        prep_pattern = r"\b(in|on|at|to|for|with|by|from|of|about|into|through|during|before|after|above|below|between|under|over)\b"
        prepositions = len(re.findall(prep_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        prep_ratio = prepositions / word_count
        conj_pattern = r"\b(and|but|or|nor|yet|so|for|because|although|while|since|unless|if|when|where|whether)\b"
        conjunctions = len(re.findall(conj_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
        conj_ratio = conjunctions / word_count
        adverbs = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("ly"))
        adv_ratio = adverbs / word_count
        past_tense = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("ed") and len(w) > 3)
        present_part = sum(1 for w in words if w.endswith("ing") and len(w) > 4)
        verb_marker_ratio = (past_tense + present_part) / word_count
        question_marks = text_str.count("?")
        exclam_marks = text_str.count("!")
        punctuation_markers = (question_marks + exclam_marks) / max(len(text_str), 1)
        ellipsis = text_str.count("...") + text_str.count("--")
        punctuation_density = ellipsis / max(len(text_str), 1)
        features.append(
            [
                pronoun_ratio,
                article_ratio,
                prep_ratio,
                conj_ratio,
                adv_ratio,
                verb_marker_ratio,
                punctuation_markers,
                punctuation_density,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


def create_tfidf_features(train_texts, val_texts, test_texts, max_features=2000):
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=max_features,
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        analyzer="char_wb",
        min_df=5,
        max_df=0.9,
        sublinear_tf=True,
    )
    tfidf_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
    tfidf_val = vectorizer.transform(val_texts)
    tfidf_test = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)
    return tfidf_train, tfidf_val, tfidf_test, vectorizer


def create_word_ngram_features(train_texts, val_texts, test_texts, max_features=1500):
    vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
        max_features=max_features, ngram_range=(1, 4), min_df=3, max_df=0.95
    )
    ngram_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
    ngram_val = vectorizer.transform(val_texts)
    ngram_test = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)
    return ngram_train, ngram_val, ngram_test, vectorizer


# Extract classical features
print("Extracting classical features...")
styl_train = extract_stylometric_features(X_train)
styl_val = extract_stylometric_features(X_val)
styl_test = extract_stylometric_features(X_test_raw)

pos_train = extract_pos_style_features(X_train)
pos_val = extract_pos_style_features(X_val)
pos_test = extract_pos_style_features(X_test_raw)

char_tfidf_train, char_tfidf_val, char_tfidf_test, _ = create_tfidf_features(
    X_train, X_val, X_test_raw, max_features=2000
)
word_ngram_train, word_ngram_val, word_ngram_test, _ = create_word_ngram_features(
    X_train, X_val, X_test_raw, max_features=1500
)

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
styl_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(styl_train)
styl_val_scaled = scaler.transform(styl_val)
styl_test_scaled = scaler.transform(styl_test)

pos_scaler = StandardScaler()
pos_train_scaled = pos_scaler.fit_transform(pos_train)
pos_val_scaled = pos_scaler.transform(pos_val)
pos_test_scaled = pos_scaler.transform(pos_test)

X_train_features = hstack(
    [
        csr_matrix(styl_train_scaled),
        csr_matrix(pos_train_scaled),
        char_tfidf_train,
        word_ngram_train,
    ]
)
X_val_features = hstack(
    [
        csr_matrix(styl_val_scaled),
        csr_matrix(pos_val_scaled),
        char_tfidf_val,
        word_ngram_val,
    ]
)
X_test_features = hstack(
    [
        csr_matrix(styl_test_scaled),
        csr_matrix(pos_test_scaled),
        char_tfidf_test,
        word_ngram_test,
    ]
)

print(
    f"Classical features shape - Train: {X_train_features.shape}, Val: {X_val_features.shape}, Test: {X_test_features.shape}"
)

# =============================================
# Smaller Transformer Feature Extraction (distilbert)
# =============================================
print("Loading distilbert-base-uncased...")
MODEL_NAME = "distilbert-base-uncased"
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = model.cuda()
model.eval()
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
print(
    f"distilbert-base-uncased loaded. Parameters frozen: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}"
)


def extract_embeddings(texts, batch_size=8, max_length=256):
    embeddings = []
    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch_texts = texts[i : i + batch_size]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            (
                batch_texts.tolist()
                if hasattr(batch_texts, "tolist")
                else list(batch_texts)
            ),
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding=True,
            truncation=True,
            max_length=max_length,
        )
        inputs = {k: v.cuda() for k, v in inputs.items()}
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(**inputs)
            # Use the [CLS] token embedding (first token)
            cls_emb = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :].cpu().numpy()
            embeddings.append(cls_emb)
        # Aggressively free memory
        del inputs, outputs, cls_emb
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    result = np.vstack(embeddings)
    gc.collect()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    return result


print("Extracting transformer embeddings...")
train_emb = extract_embeddings(X_train)
gc.collect()
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
val_emb = extract_embeddings(X_val)
gc.collect()
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
test_emb = extract_embeddings(X_test_raw)
gc.collect()
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# Convert sparse classical features to dense numpy for stacking
X_train_dense = X_train_features.toarray()
X_val_dense = X_val_features.toarray()
X_test_dense = X_test_features.toarray()

# Combine all features
X_train_combined = np.hstack([train_emb, X_train_dense])
X_val_combined = np.hstack([val_emb, X_val_dense])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([test_emb, X_test_dense])

print(
    f"Combined feature shapes - Train: {X_train_combined.shape}, Val: {X_val_combined.shape}, Test: {X_test_combined.shape}"
)

# Free memory
del model, tokenizer
gc.collect()
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# =============================================
# XGBoost Training (Two-Stage with Hard Negative Mining)
# =============================================
# Free memory before XGBoost
gc.collect()
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
print("Setting up XGBoost...")
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
val_scores = []
val_preds_list = []
val_true_list = []

xgb_params = {
    "objective": "multi:softprob",
    "num_class": num_classes,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 1,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 2.0,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "eval_metric": "mlogloss",
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "verbosity": 0,
}

print("Training XGBoost with cross-validation (using combined train data)...")
all_train_combined = np.vstack([X_train_combined, X_val_combined])
all_y = np.concatenate([y_train, y_val])

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(all_train_combined, all_y)):
    X_tr, X_val_fold = all_train_combined[train_idx], all_train_combined[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val_fold = all_y[train_idx], all_y[val_idx]

    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_fold, label=y_val_fold)

    model_xgb = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=500,
        evals=[(dval, "val")],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )

    val_pred = model_xgb.predict(dval)
    fold_score = log_loss(y_val_fold, val_pred)
    val_scores.append(fold_score)
    val_preds_list.append(val_pred)
    val_true_list.append(y_val_fold)

def extract_stylometric_features(text_series):
    features = []

        caps_ratio = caps_count / max(char_count, 1)

                avg_sent_len,

        prep_pattern = r"\b(in|on|at|to|for|with|by|from|of|about|into|through|during|before|after|above|below|between|under|over)\b"

def extract_embeddings(texts, batch_size=16, max_length=512):
    embeddings = []
    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch_texts = texts[i : i + batch_size]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            (
                batch_texts.tolist()
                if hasattr(batch_texts, "tolist")
                else list(batch_texts)
            ),
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding=True,
            truncation=True,
            max_length=max_length,
        )
        inputs = {k: v.cuda() for k, v in inputs.items()}
        with torch.no_grad(), autocast():

            hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-2]
            attention_mask = inputs["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(-1).float()
            pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask).sum(dim=1) / attention_mask.sum(
                dim=1
            )
            embeddings.append(pooled.cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(embeddings)

def compute_stylometric_features(text):
    """Compute stylometric features from text."""
    features = {}
    text_str = str(text)
    total_chars = len(text_str) + 1e-10
    words = text_str.split()
    total_words = len(words) + 1e-10
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]+', text_str)
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    total_sentences = len(sentences) + 1e-10

    # Punctuation density
    punct_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c in '.,;:!?\"\'()-[]{}')
    features['punct_density'] = punct_count / total_chars

    # Uppercase ratio
    uppercase_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isupper())
    features['uppercase_ratio'] = uppercase_count / total_chars

    # Average sentence length (in words)
    avg_sentence_len = total_words / total_sentences
    features['avg_sentence_len'] = avg_sentence_len

    # Average word length
    avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / total_words
    features['avg_word_len'] = avg_word_len

    # Stopword ratio (simple list)
    stopwords = {'the', 'a', 'an', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for', 'of', 'with', 'by', 'from', 'as', 'is', 'was', 'are', 'were', 'be', 'been', 'being', 'have', 'has', 'had', 'do', 'does', 'did', 'will', 'would', 'can', 'could', 'may', 'might', 'shall', 'should', 'not', 'no', 'nor', 'it', 'its', 'this', 'that', 'these', 'those', 'i', 'you', 'he', 'she', 'we', 'they', 'me', 'him', 'her', 'us', 'them', 'my', 'your', 'his', 'her', 'its', 'our', 'their', 'mine', 'yours', 'his', 'hers', 'ours', 'theirs'}
    stopword_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in stopwords)
    features['stopword_ratio'] = stopword_count / total_words

    # Comma ratio
    comma_count = text_str.count(',')
    features['comma_ratio'] = comma_count / total_chars

    # Exclamation ratio
    exclaim_count = text_str.count('!')
    features['exclaim_ratio'] = exclaim_count / total_chars

    # Question ratio
    question_count = text_str.count('?')
    features['question_ratio'] = question_count / total_chars

    # Quote density
    quote_count = text_str.count('"') + text_str.count("'")
    features['quote_density'] = quote_count / total_chars

    # Digit ratio
    digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
    features['digit_ratio'] = digit_count / total_chars

    # Contraction count (he's, don't, etc.)
    contraction_pattern = r"\b\w+'(?:t|s|re|ve|ll|d|m)\b"
    contractions = len(re.findall(contraction_pattern, text_str, re.IGNORECASE))
    features['contraction_ratio'] = contractions / total_words

    # Unique word ratio (type-token ratio)
    unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
    features['type_token_ratio'] = unique_words / total_words

    return features

def compute_simple_pos_features(text):
    """Compute POS-like linguistic features using simple pattern matching (no external dependency)."""
    features = {}
    text_str = str(text)
    if len(text_str.strip()) == 0:
        features['pronoun_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['article_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['preposition_ratio'] = 0.0
        features['contains_that'] = 0.0
        features['contains_which'] = 0.0
        features['contains_been'] = 0.0
        return features

    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text_str.lower())
    total_words = len(words) + 1e-10

    # Common English pronouns
    pronouns = {'i', 'you', 'he', 'she', 'it', 'we', 'they', 'me', 'him', 'her', 'us', 'them',
                'my', 'your', 'his', 'its', 'our', 'their', 'mine', 'yours', 'hers', 'ours', 'theirs',
                'myself', 'yourself', 'himself', 'herself', 'itself', 'ourselves', 'themselves',
                'who', 'whom', 'which', 'that', 'this', 'these', 'those'}
    # Common articles/determiners
    articles = {'a', 'an', 'the', 'some', 'any', 'no', 'every', 'each', 'all', 'both', 'few', 'several'}
    # Common prepositions
    prepositions = {'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for', 'of', 'with', 'by', 'from', 'as', 'into', 'through',
                    'during', 'before', 'after', 'above', 'below', 'between', 'under', 'over', 'without',
                    'within', 'along', 'around', 'among', 'about', 'against', 'since', 'until'}
    # Common be-verbs
    be_verbs = {'am', 'is', 'are', 'was', 'were', 'be', 'been', 'being'}
    # Common have-verbs
    have_verbs = {'have', 'has', 'had', 'having'}
    # Common do-verbs
    do_verbs = {'do', 'does', 'did', 'doing', 'done'}

    pronoun_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in pronouns)
    article_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in articles)
    preposition_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in prepositions)
    be_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in be_verbs)
    have_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in have_verbs)
    do_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in do_verbs)

    features['pronoun_ratio'] = pronoun_count / total_words
    features['article_ratio'] = article_count / total_words
    features['preposition_ratio'] = preposition_count / total_words
    features['be_verb_ratio'] = be_count / total_words
    features['have_verb_ratio'] = have_count / total_words
    features['do_verb_ratio'] = do_count / total_words
    # Subordinate conjunctions / relative pronouns as complexity signals
    features['contains_that'] = 1.0 if 'that' in words else 0.0
    features['contains_which'] = 1.0 if 'which' in words else 0.0
    features['contains_been'] = 1.0 if 'been' in words else 0.0

    return features

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Precompute handcrafted features for all texts

print("Computing handcrafted features...")

all_texts = pd.concat([train_df["text"], test_df["text"]], ignore_index=True).values

stylo_features_list = [compute_stylometric_features(t) for t in all_texts]
stylo_df = pd.DataFrame(stylo_features_list)
print(f"Stylometric features shape: {stylo_df.shape}")

# Split handcrafted features before scaling
train_handcrafted_df = handcrafted_df.iloc[:len(train_df)]
test_handcrafted_df = handcrafted_df.iloc[len(train_df):]

# Scale handcrafted features (fit on train only)
scaler = StandardScaler()
train_handcrafted = scaler.fit_transform(train_handcrafted_df.values.astype(np.float32))
test_handcrafted = scaler.transform(test_handcrafted_df.values.astype(np.float32))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TF-IDF features (fit on train only)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("Computing TF-IDF features...")
train_texts = [str(t) for t in train_df["text"].values]
test_texts = [str(t) for t in test_df["text"].values]

tfidf_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer='char',
    ngram_range=(1, 4),
    max_features=2000,
    sublinear_tf=True
)
train_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts).toarray().astype(np.float32)
test_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(test_texts).toarray().astype(np.float32)
print(f"TF-IDF features shape: {train_tfidf.shape}")

# Extract DeBERTa embeddings
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("Extracting DeBERTa embeddings...")
def extract_embeddings(texts, backbone, tokenizer, device, batch_size=32, max_length=256):
    embeddings_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
            batch_texts = [str(t) for t in texts[i:i+batch_size]]
            encodings = tokenizer(
                batch_texts,
                truncation=True,
                padding=True,
                max_length=max_length,
                return_tensors="pt"
            )
            input_ids = encodings["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = encodings["attention_mask"].to(device)

            outputs = backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
            # Use [CLS] token embedding (pooled output)
            cls_embeddings = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :].cpu().numpy()
            embeddings_list.append(cls_embeddings)

            del input_ids, attention_mask, outputs
            if i % 100 == 0:
                gc.collect()
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return np.concatenate(embeddings_list, axis=0)

train_embeddings = extract_embeddings(train_df["text"].values, backbone, tokenizer, device)
test_embeddings = extract_embeddings(test_df["text"].values, backbone, tokenizer, device)
print(f"DeBERTa embeddings shape: {train_embeddings.shape}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine all features
# ------------------------------------------------------------
X_train = np.concatenate([train_embeddings, train_handcrafted, train_tfidf], axis=1)
X_test = np.concatenate([test_embeddings, test_handcrafted, test_tfidf], axis=1)
print(f"Combined feature shape: {X_train.shape[1]}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create classification head and dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------
class ClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_classes=3, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(input_dim, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.dropout(x)
        return self.classifier(x)

input_dim = X_train.shape[1]
head = ClassificationHead(input_dim, num_classes=3, dropout=0.3)
head.to(device)

# Compute class weights
class_counts = torch.tensor([6860, 5392, 5369], dtype=torch.float32)
class_weights = class_counts.sum() / (3 * class_counts)
class_weights = class_weights.to(device)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(weight=class_weights)

# Optimizer - higher LR for the head only
optimizer = AdamW(
    head.parameters(),
    lr=5e-4,
    weight_decay=0.01,
)

# Dataset for precomputed features
class FeatureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, features, labels=None):
        self.features = torch.tensor(features, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.features)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {"features": self.features[idx]}
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# Create train/validation split (stratified)
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(train_df)), test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=train_labels
)

X_train_split = X_train[train_idx]
y_train_split = train_labels[train_idx]
X_val_split = X_train[val_idx]
y_val_split = train_labels[val_idx]

batch_size = 64
train_dataset = FeatureDataset(X_train_split, y_train_split)
val_dataset = FeatureDataset(X_val_split, y_val_split)
test_dataset = FeatureDataset(X_test, labels=None)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)

print(f"Train samples: {len(train_dataset)}, Val samples: {len(val_dataset)}, Test samples: {len(test_dataset)}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Training Setup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def extract_embeddings(texts, backbone, tokenizer, device, batch_size=32, max_length=256):
    embeddings_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
            batch_texts = [str(t) for t in texts[i:i+batch_size]]
            encodings = tokenizer(
                batch_texts,
                truncation=True,
                padding=True,
                max_length=max_length,
                return_tensors="pt"
            )
            input_ids = encodings["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = encodings["attention_mask"].to(device)

            outputs = backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
            # Use [CLS] token embedding (pooled output)
            cls_embeddings = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :].cpu().numpy()
            embeddings_list.append(cls_embeddings)

            del input_ids, attention_mask, outputs
            if i % 100 == 0:
                gc.collect()
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return np.concatenate(embeddings_list, axis=0)

import torch

# Set device
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Encode target

# Load tokenizer and backbone model - DistilRoBERTa-base (to be fine-tuned)

backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_id)

# Initially freeze all backbone layers; we will gradually unfreeze top 4 layers after epoch 3
